audit_note: The repository contains design-system, client-portal, premium landing-page, and visual-fidelity research. Named vendor studies requested for Orca, T3 Code, Penpot, Excalidraw, and Granular were not found as standalone canonical artifacts; they are not treated as proven requirements.

patterns.source_name: Got Funding / client portal design audit
patterns.problem_it_solves: A client portal that feels like a placeholder reduces trust.
patterns.key_idea: Use premium typography, compact hierarchy, clear CTAs, trust signals, and mobile-first spacing as the quality bar.
patterns.current_nexus_equivalent: client-v2 theme, AppShellV2, existing premium GoClear public styles
patterns.why_useful: Directly addresses the recorded 35/100 portal quality audit.
patterns.why_not_useful: A premium visual layer cannot substitute for real data isolation.

patterns.source_name: Nexus 3 design system and client journey artifacts
patterns.problem_it_solves: Showing every capability at first login overwhelms a new client.
patterns.key_idea: Show current stage, one next action, and only the supporting details needed now.
patterns.why_useful: Existing components already express staged progress.
patterns.why_not_useful: Current root routing does not yet enforce onboarding completion.

patterns.problem_it_solves: Build success does not prove visual quality.
patterns.key_idea: Render real viewports, inspect screenshots, and record visual defects separately from functional tests.
patterns.current_nexus_equivalent: Playwright dependency and existing visual-fidelity reports
patterns.why_useful: Matches the required reference → build → screenshot → critique loop.
patterns.why_not_useful: No subjective territory should be promoted without Ray review.

patterns.source_name: Client portal research and journey implementation
patterns.problem_it_solves: New clients do not know what to do next.
patterns.key_idea: Make the next safe action the dominant CTA and explain why it matters.
patterns.why_useful: The current code already has the needed action surfaces.
patterns.why_not_useful: The action must be derived from real client state, not demo defaults.

patterns.problem_it_solves: A first client experience can fail on a phone even when desktop is usable.
patterns.key_idea: Collapse navigation, preserve CTA prominence, and keep upload/review states readable at narrow widths.
patterns.why_useful: Existing tokens and responsive shell reduce new surface area.
patterns.why_not_useful: Requires actual browser rendering to certify.

patterns.source_name: Client portal implementation and runtime safety reports
patterns.problem_it_solves: Synthetic fixtures can be mistaken for client progress.
patterns.key_idea: Keep REAL, SYNTHETIC, DEMO, and CERTIFICATION data classes explicit and render empty states when real records are absent.
patterns.why_useful: This is a safety requirement, not cosmetic polish.
patterns.why_not_useful: A badge alone is insufficient; query fallbacks must also be safe.

patterns.source_name: Nexus research and Hermes/Nova shared-awareness work
patterns.problem_it_solves: Separate interfaces can answer from contradictory state.
patterns.key_idea: Use one canonical structured brief/evidence packet while allowing different conversational presentation.
patterns.current_nexus_equivalent: shared operational reads and Daily Brief
patterns.why_useful: Already proven in the operator-awareness layer.
patterns.why_not_useful: Client-facing Hermes must be filtered from operator data.

patterns.problem_it_solves: Potentially useful design/build/research workflows may be missed.
patterns.key_idea: Audit named tools as pattern references, not as automatic dependencies.
patterns.current_nexus_equivalent: Playwright, existing design reports, local React/Vite
patterns.why_not_useful: No local canonical research artifact or proven capability gap was found in this audit; installing now would violate install-last.
